name: miaoda-game-ballistics-core
description: Engine-agnostic ballistic-motion core: launch-velocity solving (fire at a target with a chosen speed, angle, or arc apex — low and high solutions), gravity integration with linear drag, restitution bounces, and landing / trajectory prediction for aim guides. Orientation-free (gravity is a vector you pass in), so the same math drives a top-down volley with a height axis and a side-view cannon. No rendering, no engine dependency. Backs thrown grenades, artillery, basketball / tennis / golf arcs, jump trajectories and lob-aim indicator lines.
